meta.name: company-intel
meta.description: Research a company, industry, or competitor set using web search and seven analytical lenses. Use when you need structured intel that feeds downstream PM skills.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速摸清公司、行业与竞争对手底细，输出结构化情报
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解某家公司或某个赛道的竞争格局
copy.tagline_en: Turn web research into structured company and competitor intelligence
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand a company or competitive landscape before decisions

howto.what: 装好后，你要求调研某家公司、某个行业或一组竞争对手时，Claude 会用网络搜索收集信息，按七个分析镜头（财务、市场、产品、竞争、趋势、产品管理、战略信号）整理成结构化报告，并标注来源。报告可交给其他技能继续生成 battlecard、SWOT 等。
howto.when: 当你说出“调研某公司”“分析某个行业”“对比几家公司”等请求，或要求“找出某公司的竞争对手”时触发；输入模糊时它会先问一句。

say.text: 调研一下 Figma 和它的前三大竞争对手，用于下周的定位工作坊。
say.note: 会先确认竞争对手列表，再出完整对比报告。

say.text: 给我讲讲临床数据管理行业的现状和趋势。
say.note: 按行业入口分析，并连接产品经理启示。

howto.what_en: After installation, when you ask to research a company, industry, or competitor set, Claude gathers info via web search and organizes it into a structured report across seven analytical lenses, citing sources. The report can feed downstream skills like battlecards or SWOT.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to research a company, analyze an industry, compare companies, or discover a company's competitors; if input is ambiguous, it asks a clarifying question.

say_en.text: Research Figma and its top 3 competitors for next week's positioning workshop.
say_en.note: Confirms the competitor list, then runs the full comparison.

say_en.text: Give me an overview of the clinical data management industry.
say_en.note: Runs the industry entry point, linking findings to PM implications.

say_en.text: Compare Helix Motion, Northfield Automation, and Corvid Industrial.
say_en.note: Produces per-company reports plus a cross-company comparison.
